newsitem.title: USA: Southwest Bancorp eyes card portfolio sale.
newsitem.headline: Southwest Bancorp eyes card portfolio sale.

text.p: Southwest Bancorp Inc said Thursday its principal subsidiary, Stillwater National Bank and Trust Co, is negotiating the potential sale of all or a substantial part of its credit card portfolio.
Southwest said the possible deal would be at a premium before taxes but net of other related expenses and the value of the deal is preliminarily estimated at $3.0-$4.5 million.

Southwest said the deal is subject to negotiation of a definitive agreement and due diligence by the potential acquirer, which it did not identify. It said if conditions were met, the deal would be completed within the year.
